headline: Connecticut DOT worker killed while doing road maintenance on I-95
dek: Elvin Hernandez, 60, was struck by a vehicle Friday in Fairfield, according to the governor's office, which is urging drivers to slow down and move over around highway work crews.
body: A Connecticut Department of Transportation employee was killed Friday while doing road maintenance on Interstate 95 in Fairfield, Gov. Ned Lamont's office said.

Elvin Hernandez, 60, had worked for CTDOT since 2010 and was based at the agency's Stratford garage. State officials did not announce funeral arrangements Friday, but Lamont's office said flags will be lowered to half-staff when services are scheduled.

Lamont, Lt. Gov. Susan Bysiewicz and CTDOT Commissioner Garrett Eucalitto urged drivers to slow down, move over, put away their phones and pay attention around work zones. Eucalitto said the death underscored the risks faced by the agency's highway crews as they work along active roads.

The governor's office described the incident as a heartbreaking loss for Hernandez's family, colleagues and Connecticut state government. The official announcement did not provide additional details about the crash or identify the driver.
author: NorthEast News Desk
seoTitle: Connecticut DOT worker killed on I-95 in Fairfield
seoDescription: CTDOT employee Elvin Hernandez was killed while doing road maintenance on I-95 in Fairfield, according to Connecticut officials.
